# Ticket breakdown

Applies to Autonomous production engineering (web application). Follow `AGENTS.md` first.

## Procedure

1. Identify the vertical slices that each deliver observable value.
2. Sequence slices so every one leaves the default branch releasable.
3. For each ticket write scope, acceptance criteria, and test expectations.
4. Mark dependencies between tickets explicitly.
5. Estimate risk, not time, and call out the riskiest ticket.

## Output

An ordered list of tickets ready to assign to implementation.
